draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and ordinary, the everyday feeling of holding a common object
notes: As 'bottle' (瓶), 병 is also used as a counter after native Korean numbers: 물 한 병 (one bottle of water), 맥주 두 병 (two bottles of beer).
As 'illness' (病), it is commonly used in the phrase 병에 걸리다 (to get sick / catch a disease) and 병이 나다 (to fall ill).
